reason: The mathematics item uses the rotating shallow-water equation family as premise [F1]. The supplied library rule forbids mathematical items from depending on physics items, so this dependency invalidates the item.
The claim that N>0 is essential for positivity is false: 1/N² is positive for every N≠0, including N<0. Only N=0 makes the displayed energy undefined; positivity depends on N².

The final sentence refers to “energy integrals below,” but no energy integral is defined anywhere in the item; its stated density scaling and joule interpretation therefore have no mathematical referent.

`p_0` may be arbitrary while being called the pressure of the resting reference state. Vallis §1.6.2 (pp. 13–14) imposes hydrostatic balance; without it a residual force remains, so these perturbation equations are not a linearization about that state.
